name: Coefficient-Ratio Zero Criterion and Gap
statement: $\tau(C)=0$ exactly when shared coefficient and witness exponents satisfy strict term dominance in every concept-pattern comparison. Otherwise $\tau(C)\ge1/g(C)$, hence every positive value on $n$ coordinates is at least $1/\max(1,n-1)$.
proof: A ratio below $1/g(C)$ forces the largest favorable exponent to exceed the largest unfavorable exponent after logarithms. Conversely, exponentially dilating any strict dominance certificate drives every ratio to zero.
